units.source_text: [\[5\]](#part1330.html#w5) 旧时日本装，男子是穿裙的，现在仅用于礼服。

en.t: [5] In old Japanese dress, men wore skirt-like hakama, but today they are used only for formal attire.

units.source_text: 穿裙仪式为男童初次穿裙时举行的仪式，古时在三岁，后来也有在五岁或七岁时举行的。

en.t: The hakama-wearing ceremony was held when a boy first put on hakama; in ancient times it took place at age three, and later it was sometimes held at age five or seven.
Girls also held this kind of ceremony.
